name: Nymphomania
source:
The protagonist, Hayama Keisuke, is a most average student at a private school. And although they are not related by blood, he has an excellent relationship with his stepmother and sister.
Owing to his timid nature, he has not yet dated any girls, but he has an adequate - no, considerable - interest in sex for a boy of his age.

Indecent thoughts of his childhood friend - his classmate Yumi - never leave his mind.

But then, a single girl turns Keisuke's mundane life on its head.

Although change is yet only creeping up on him, it has nevertheless begun. And when Keisuke realizes what is about to happen, his dull life becomes increasingly disturbed day by day.

There is no way back.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.mink.co.jp/product/violet/nymphomaniahd/index.html#a_story]Official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公叶山圭介是私立学校里最普通的学生。而且虽然没有血缘关系，但是他和继母以及妹妹的关系却非常好。
由于他胆怯的天性，他还没有和任何女孩约会过，但对于同龄的男孩来说，他对性有足够的——不，相当大的——兴趣。

对儿时好友——同学由美的不雅念头始终萦绕在他的脑海中。

但随后，一个单身女孩彻底改变了圭介的平凡生活。

尽管变化才刚刚悄然降临在他身上，但它已经开始了。而当圭介意识到即将发生的事情时，他平淡的生活变得日益不安。

没有回头路了。

[翻译自[url=http://www.mink.co.jp/product/violet/nymphomaniahd/index.html#a_story]官网[/url]]
